proposals_saved_has_record.name: proposals_saved_has_record
proposals_saved_has_record.value: "proposals"."status" <> 'saved' or ("proposals"."record_id" is not null and "proposals"."decided_at" is not null)

reports_sent_requires_consent.name: reports_sent_requires_consent
reports_sent_requires_consent.value: "reports"."status" <> 'sent' or ("reports"."sent_at" is not null and "reports"."consent_id" is not null and "reports"."recipient" is not null)
